WorkflowsBrew 8 · Nitro

Run cold outbound

Send cold email that lands: check the lead list before it loads, size and protect the sending setup, then write the copy.

The steps, in order.

  1. Step 1

    Cold Email List Gate Gate a cold-email lead list before it loads: sample ten rows, check company, title, size, and mailbox against the ICP, compare data providers on the same criteria, and return a GO or HOLD decision with the fail pattern and the re-run… v1.0.0

  2. Step 2

    Cold Email Ops Plan and audit a cold-email program at volume and keep it from degrading: computes inbox and domain capacity from a monthly send target, sets per-domain reply-rate floors, burn-replacement cadence, shadow-ban tests, and automation error… v1.0.0

  3. Step 3

    Sales Copy Writes buyer-facing conversion assets: long-form sales pages, landing pages, launch and abandoned-cart email sequences and ad variations, built on the offer and the objections you can actually back. v1.0.0

Install the whole workflow.

npx skills add arm-pz/cold-email-list-gate  # step 1
npx skills add arm-pz/cold-email-ops        # step 2
npx skills add arm-pz/sales-copy            # step 3

In Claude Code you can take every skill at once instead: /plugin marketplace add arm-pz/caffeinity-skills, then /plugin install caffeinity@caffeinity-skills. Not sure this is the right workflow? Install caffeinity-routing and describe the outcome; it picks one.
